The '''Ec Pand system''' was part of the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ec Pand]]. Rather than the more common [[Navigation buoy/Legends|beacon-buoy]] most systems used to mark their jump zone, the system used a large asteroid, towed there by the local government.

The privateer ship, the ''[[Free Lance]]'' once raided the system.
